findings.message: The proposed recipe changes /opt/demo ownership from 584792:584792 (run-user _daemon_) to 0:0 (root) and permissions from 0750 to 0700. The application must open /opt/demo/server.conf at startup with no fallback and has no DAC override or root helper. This breaks runtime access; _daemon_ cannot read or execute a root-owned 0700 directory. Compare recipes/before/rockcraft.yaml:30,33 to recipes/after/rockcraft.yaml:30,33. The PR description does not confirm this breaking change as intentional.

summary: Recipe changes limited to override-build script: /opt/demo directory ownership changed from run-user to root and permissions tightened from 0750 to 0700. No parts, services, or package changes. Comparison fully assessed via supplied snapshots.
